topic: Directional Light Service Request Signal Definition
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific signal or its value definition related to directional light service requests.

core_entities.name: DirLghtSrvReq
core_entities.description: Directional Light Service Request signal, indicating the desired direction light operation.

core_outputs.name: DirLghtSrvReq_0_No_Flash
core_outputs.description: No flash request for directional lights.

core_outputs.name: DirLghtSrvReq_1_Left_Direction_Light_Flash
core_outputs.description: Request for left direction light flash.

core_outputs.name: DirLghtSrvReq_2_Right_Direction_Light_Flash
core_outputs.description: Request for right direction light flash.

core_outputs.name: DirLghtSrvReq_3_Both_Side_Direction_Light_Flash
core_outputs.description: Request for both side direction light flash.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the encoding and meaning of the DirLghtSrvReq signal used in CAN communication for requesting directional light operations. It is used to verify that the correct signal value is transmitted by the S32G MCU via LHZCU through BKBCANFD filter, corresponding to the intended direction light behavior (no flash, left flash, right flash, or both sides flash).
